-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.CutDefs` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def mvcc.CmpRecs.resumes (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) : Bool :=
  decide (r.schedRev ≠ 0 ∧ r.finRev < r.schedRev)

def mvcc.CmpRecs.schedRev (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) : Int :=
  (Option.map sint.Z r.sched).getD 0

def mvcc.recsPos (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) : Prop :=
  (∀ (x : w64), r.fin = some x → 1 ≤ sint.Z x) ∧ ∀ (x : w64), r.sched = some x → 1 ≤ sint.Z x

def mvcc.CmpRecs.crev (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) : Int :=
  if r.resumes = true then r.schedRev else r.finRev

def mvcc.bucketOfEnts (ents : List mvcc.KvEnt) : mvcc.Bucket :=
  List.foldl (fun m p => <[p.fst := p.snd]>m) GMap.empty (List.map mvcc.KvEnt.pair ents)

structure mvcc.CmpRecs : Type where
  fin : Option w64
  sched : Option w64

def mvcc.recsOk (L : mvcc.Log) (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) : Prop :=
  (∀ (x : w64), r.fin = some x → 0 ≤ sint.Z x ∧ sint.Z x < ↑(List.length L)) ∧
    ∀ (x : w64), r.sched = some x → 0 ≤ sint.Z x ∧ sint.Z x < ↑(List.length L)

def mvcc.CmpRecs.finRev (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) : Int :=
  (Option.map sint.Z r.fin).getD (-1)

structure mvcc.KvEnt : Type where
  rev : mvcc.Rev
  tomb : Bool
  kv : EtcdKv

def mvcc.snap.jobPast (L : mvcc.Log) (c₁ : Int) (p : mvcc.Rev) (ents : List mvcc.KvEnt) : Prop :=
  ∀ (e' : mvcc.KvEnt),
    e' ∈ mvcc.logEnts L 0 (List.length L) → e'.rev.lt p → mvcc.KeyDel L c₁ (mvcc.revBytes e'.rev e'.tomb) → ¬e' ∈ ents

def mvcc.entsCutAt (L : mvcc.Log) (c : Int) (ents : List mvcc.KvEnt) : Prop :=
  ents.Sublist (mvcc.logEnts L 0 (List.length L)) ∧
    (∀ (e : mvcc.KvEnt),
        e ∈ mvcc.logEnts L 0 (List.length L) → ¬e ∈ ents → mvcc.KeyDel L c (mvcc.revBytes e.rev e.tomb)) ∧
      ∀ (e₁ : mvcc.KvEnt),
        e₁ ∈ mvcc.logEnts L 0 (List.length L) →
          ∀ (e₂ : mvcc.KvEnt),
            e₂ ∈ mvcc.logEnts L 0 (List.length L) → e₁.kv.key = e₂.kv.key → e₁.rev.lt e₂.rev → ¬e₂ ∈ ents → ¬e₁ ∈ ents

def mvcc.recBytes (x : Option w64) : Option GoString :=
  Option.map (fun x => mvcc.revBytes { main := x, sub := W64 0 } false) x

def mvcc.logEnts (log : mvcc.Log) (lo hi : Nat) : List mvcc.KvEnt :=
  (List.map (fun m => mvcc.entsOfRev m (mvcc.stateAt log (m - 1)) (List.getD log m []))
      (List.range' lo (hi - lo))).flatten

def mvcc.CmpRecs.empty : mvcc.CmpRecs :=
  { fin := none, sched := none }

def mvcc.Bucket : Type :=
  GMap GoString GoString

def mvcc.snap.physLookup (m : mvcc.Bucket) (X : backend.VData) (k : GoString) : Option GoString :=
  if (X !! (mvcc.keyName, k)).isSome = true then none else m !! k

def mvcc.KvEnt.pair (e : mvcc.KvEnt) : GoString × GoString :=
  (mvcc.revBytes e.rev e.tomb, mvcc.kvEncode e.kv)

def mvcc.snap.cutOk (L : mvcc.Log) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (X : backend.VData) (c : Int) : Prop :=
  ∃ ents,
    mvcc.entsCutAt L c ents ∧
      ∀ (k : GoString), (if (X !! (mvcc.keyName, k)).isSome = true then none else m !! k) = mvcc.bucketOfEnts ents !! k

def mvcc.instDecidableEqCmpRecs : DecidableEq mvcc.CmpRecs :=
  mvcc.instDecidableEqCmpRecs.decEq

def mvcc.entsOfRev (r : Nat) (before : List EtcdKv) (cs : List mvcc.Change) : List mvcc.KvEnt :=
  List.filterMap
    (fun p =>
      Option.map (fun kv => { rev := { main := W64 ↑r, sub := W64 ↑p.snd }, tomb := p.fst.isDel, kv := kv })
        (mvcc.changeKv (W64 ↑r) before cs p.snd))
    cs.zipIdx

def mvcc.keyName : GoString :=
  go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.keyName

def mvcc.instDecidableEqCmpRecs.decEq (x✝ x✝¹ : mvcc.CmpRecs) : Decidable (x✝ = x✝¹) :=
  match x✝¹, x✝ with
  | { fin := a, sched := a_1 }, { fin := b, sched := b_1 } =>
    if h : a = b then h ▸ if h : a_1 = b_1 then h ▸ isTrue ⋯ else isFalse ⋯ else isFalse ⋯
